title: Specified completed strict limit from a compatible finite-projective marking
statement: For the completed coefficient system of an adic datum d [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], let Z be a strict derived tower on X and U a pro-etale object. Suppose a compatible algebraic local tower comparison is given [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-extraction]. Let P be a bounded finite-projective A-complex [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex] with reductions compatibly marked to this algebraic tower. Then exact derived slice restriction of the specified total right derived inverse limit of Z is isomorphic to completed constant realization of P on U [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. This theorem assembles restriction, diagram transport, and uniqueness of Roos limits, using the separate marked finite-projective calculation [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-marked-roos].

source.place: Tag 09C6, lemma-connected-adic-lisse: take the derived limit of compatible local quotient markings; Cohomology on Sites, Tags 0940 and 0941.

proof.text: Take a K-injective resolution of the chosen strict representative. Exact countable products give its Roos triangle, and the total-right-derived-functor comparison identifies the limit object with the specified reconstructionRlim. Level evaluation inverts the resolution quasi-isomorphism; transport the triangle along this diagram isomorphism.

Apply the proved derived-restriction Roos theorem: the localized exact adjunction makes restriction a product-preserving triangulated right adjoint, hence it carries the specified global Roos limit to the restricted diagram.

Transport the restricted Roos triangle through the compatible local diagram comparison. The adjunction-unit marking theorem identifies this algebraic diagram with the canonical quotient diagram. Apply the finite-projective Roos calculation to that canonical diagram and transport once more. Uniqueness of derived limits gives the required isomorphism.

theorem finitePerfectAdicTower_limit
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [IsAdicComplete d.ideal A] (U : X.ProEt)
    (Z : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicTowers X d))
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicLocalTower X d U Z)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    (ha : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (hb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hP : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective A (P.X i) ∧ Module.Finite A (P.X i))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, (T.extension n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ T.level n)
    (he : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (T.adjunction (n + 1)).unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (DerivedCategory.adicLevelRestriction d.ideal (n + 1)).map (e (n + 1)).hom ≫
          DerivedCategory.adicTowerTransition d.ideal T.level T.transition n =
        (T.adjunction n).unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (DerivedCategory.adicLevelRestriction d.ideal n).map (e n).hom) :
    Nonempty
      ((ringedDerivedRestrictionGeneral.{t + 1, t, t + 1, t + 1}
          (completedAdicRing X d) U).obj ((reconstructionRlim X d).obj Z) ≅
        (finitePerfectAdicLocalRealization X d U).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
